Splendid September at Pato!
We kicked off the month with a truly wonderful Teacher’s Day class—a heartfelt thank you to all the parents and little ones for making us feel so special! 

We’ve had a Splendid September filled with discovery and joy. From exploring different painting forms and working our fine motor skills with pincer grip exercises, to a whole lot of sensory magic and unapologetic messy fun—it all happens right here at Pato! 

Come for the mess and the memories... and leave the clean-up to us! 

DM or call 9019265207 to book a spot with us!
